papers.title: Precise Deep-Learning Reconstruction of Galaxy Cluster Mass Maps and Substructures from Optical Observations
papers.summary: Deep-learning models trained on hydrodynamical simulations reconstruct galaxy cluster mass maps and substructures from HST optical imaging, agreeing with independent lensing measurements.

papers.title: Unsupervised Machine Learning Classification of FRB 20121102A across Distinct Active Episodes: Implications for FRB Emission Physics and Source Environments
papers.comment: 16 pages, 2 table, 13 figures. Accepted for publication in ApJ
papers.summary: Unsupervised clustering of FAST bursts from FRB 20121102A finds four spectral groups whose fractions vary across active episodes, suggesting distinct emission populations or environments.

papers.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). AstroVink-TREX: Automated strong gravitational lens segmentation as input for mass modelling pipelines
papers.summary: A vision-transformer plus convolutional network automatically separates lens, source, and contaminant light for Euclid strong lenses, enabling mass modelling at survey scale.

papers.title: Unsupervised learning reveals a small number of galaxy formation pathways in IllustrisTNG
papers.summary: UMAP and k-means applied to IllustrisTNG star formation histories identify six galaxy groups with distinct masses, morphologies, angular momenta, and merger histories.

papers.title: Augmenting Galaxy Catalogues using Machine Learning in the FLAMINGO Simulations
papers.summary: Extremely randomized trees and Gaussian-process emulation populate a dark-matter-only FLAMINGO simulation, producing a galaxy catalogue that reproduces hydrodynamical clustering statistics.

papers.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Enhancing deep-learning models: the impact of image processing and training data selection for strong-lens detection
papers.excerpt: Euclid is expected to discover ~$10^5$ galaxy-galaxy strong gravitational lenses across ~14,000deg$^2$, requiring automated searches with high completeness and low false-positive rates.
